text: Buzz--Buzz--Buzz... Buzz--Buzz--Buzz--
I often get the feeling of déjà vu when certain things happen and wonder if I have experienced this before.
Most people attribute déjà vu to an illusion associated with the hippocampus, while others believe it's due to time-space dislocation.
If you have experienced certain events in a parallel universe, then you might resonate with yourself in this time and space when they intersect.
"I" really have experienced something, but at the same time, I haven't experienced it...

For example, my phone is vibrating crazily right now, and for some reason, I just seem to know without picking it up that Nana Shiraishi is the person calling me. I also don't know why I have the feeling that I don't want to answer her call.
My mobile phone becomes quiet after it vibrates persistently for two minutes, and then I receive several text message notifications.
I sigh and crawl out of bed, then stare at the screen and shake my head to the left and the right a few times...
Okay, the face unlock failed. Every morning, the artificial intelligence makes me wonder if I look any different from how I looked yesterday.
After I enter the password, I'm not surprised to see that the missed calls and unread text messages are all from Nana Shiraishi... Life must be tough for me in that parallel world.
Nana Shiraishi
{character:Nana Shiraishi}(Text Message) Wow! Junior! Haven't you gotten up yet?
{character:Nana Shiraishi}(Text Message) You managed to sleep through all my phone calls. Have you muted your phone? I'll use text messages to tell you what I want to say then.

{character:Nana Shiraishi}(Text Message) First of all, I'm so sorry! Everyone was busy preparing for the pool party since really early in the morning yesterday, so I didn't manage to answer your call.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}(Text Message) You must be really curious about the pool party now, right?
{character:Nana Shiraishi}(Text Message) Hehe!!! Are you filled with regret now?
After the last text message is a group photo. With sunshine, a pool, swimsuits, and beautiful girls in it, the scenery in this photo has all the most beautiful elements of late summer in it.
I glance at today's weather forecast: 26-32°C.
But I can't really complain. Not every game... ah, I mean, not every city has a swimsuit party in autumn.
When I see the question Nana Shiraishi asks me at the end about whether I have any regrets, I remember how she didn't reply to my text messages yesterday.
After closing the text message screen in a relaxed manner and putting my phone away in my pocket, I decide to go out and meet Ciri as we agreed.

After arriving at Countless Springs where Ciri and I agreed to meet up, I see her waiting at the small clearing at the entrance. To my surprise, Mojito is also here, and he is yawning lazily while lying on the ground at her feet.
But the closer I get to them, the more confused I become. Although she is standing in a clearing, it is right in front of Countless Springs. Isn't it a little too empty?

With this question in mind, I look around and see that all passers-by are now staying away from this place. Two young people poke their heads out of the entrance of Countless Springs and whisper to themselves while looking in our direction with anxious expressions on their faces.

It looks like Mojito is the problem. It makes sense though, as a black panther is a ferocious predator. It's likely that no one here can match its speed or strength. Um... maybe it's too tactful to say "likely" here. At least I'm certain that I can't win in a fight against Mojito, not even if I use a sliding tackle against it.

Judging from their uniforms, the two young people behind the entrance should be staff of Countless Springs. They probably think that Mojito is bad for the business of Countless Springs as long as it's lying there on the ground, but they are also worried that it might hurt their other customers if they let Mojito in. Most importantly, I guess they aren't brave enough to go up to Ciri and Mojito and ask them to leave.
player
{character:player}Good morning, Ciri.
Ciri
{character:Ciri}Morning... You're here earlier than I expected.

At this moment, Ciri is leaning leisurely against a lamppost and playing around with Mojito's upturned tail. Mojito, on the other hand, is squinting with a look of enjoyment on its face. It looks like they haven't realized how much fear they have instilled in the people around them.

Feeling a heavy responsibility on my shoulders, I decide to help the staff of Countless Springs and do myself a favor at the same time. After all, the reason Ciri and I have come here today is to enter Countless Springs and ask Kurone Toujou what happened on the day she picked up the injured red-crowned crane.
{character:player}Ciri, why don't we take Mojito to the alley over there first? It looks like there are fewer people over there.
{character:Ciri}Oh? Why should we?
{character:player}Ahaha... Haven't you realized that everyone is a little scared of Mojito?

{character:Ciri}I was wondering why it was unusually quiet today... Mojito may look a little fierce, but it grew up in Soul and isn't as aggressive as wild black panthers. There's nothing to be scared of.
{character:player}That being said... maybe everyone has preconceived notions about black panthers and thinks they will hurt them, right?
{character:Ciri}Even wild black panthers won't hunt humans. Compared with large beasts such as tigers and lions, they are smaller and tend to choose to live far away from people.
{character:Ciri}Hmph! Humans are always worried that animals will hurt them, yet they aren't willing to admit that they are the most brutal animals in the natural world.
Upon hearing this, Mojito raises its head and growls like it is agreeing with Ciri's words.
I'm instantly reminded of the recent red-crowned crane incident. I do understand why Ciri is acting like this, but I also get a strange feeling.
Ciri... seems to have something against humans?
I often hear stories about everyone at Soul, but now that I think about it, I don't think anyone has ever mentioned Ciri's past. I wonder if I'll ever get the chance to ask her personally.
{character:player}I'm a little curious. Why did you bring Mojito today?
{character:Ciri}I got hurt when I was fighting yesterday. I didn't notice it myself either, but this fellow smelled the blood on me and insisted on coming out with me today.
After hearing Ciri's words, I notice some bandages exposed on her top near the shoulder. I can't confirm where she is injured or whether it is serious.
{character:Ciri}Don't worry, it isn't anything serious. I'm used to this already.

{character:player}It's better to not be used to something like this, but at the same time, I'm kind of envious of you... I didn't expect that Mojito is actually a knight and is willing to accompany you especially to protect you.
Mojito
{character:Mojito}*Purr*
Unless I'm mistaken, Mojito is looking at me with approval. Moreover, based on my many years of experience in raising a "cat", the sound Mojito made is a happy sound.
However, the most important thing to us right now is to get the staff to let us in. Ciri lowers her head and thinks deeply for a moment before she seems to have an idea and looks up to talk to me.
{character:Ciri}I understand what you're thinking, but I have an idea better than getting Mojito to hide.
{character:player}What is it?
{character:Ciri}If we can convince the staff that Mojito is a gentle and obedient child who won't hurt people, I think they will no longer try to stop us.
{character:player}That's a good idea! How will you help the staff understand Mojito better?
{character:Ciri}Simple, I'll get Mojito to play with them for a while. When we perform at Soul, Mojito is best at interacting with children.
{character:Ciri}Although... it does dislike humans, based on its attitude to you, I don't think it dislikes humans that much, so it should be okay.
{character:Ciri}You two can just wait for me here.
{character:player}Okay.
{character:Mojito}*Grrr*

Ciri walks over to the entrance of Countless Springs and starts talking to the staff. I don't know what she said to them, but within a few minutes, the staff follow Ciri over here and stand in front of me and Mojito.

One of them is a woman who has braids and is wearing a pair of round glasses. After approaching Mojito cautiously, she squats down and looks at it carefully for a moment before looking at Ciri. Judging from her expression, she should still be a little scared.
{character:Ciri}Relax, you'll be okay.
Mojito seems to understand the situation we're in and tries its best to appear docile, but the staff can't see past the scar on its cool face to see how docile it is.
After struggling for a while, the female staff finally decides to carefully place her hand on Mojito's head and pet Mojito gently.
Female Staff
{character:Female Staff}Wow! It really is very obedient and won't bite people!
Male Staff
{character:Male Staff}Um... Let's observe it for a little longer.

When he said he would observe for a little longer, I didn't expect the male staff to squat down in front of Mojito and scratch its chin, stroking down along its neck and back in the direction of its fur. He is a true expert at petting cats!
The two staff pet Mojito for a while and decide to let us enter Countless Springs after confirming that it won't harm anyone.
We usually fear what we don't know. If we can get the staff to realize that Mojito is just a fierce-looking "big cat," I believe they would accept it. After all, no one can say no to a cat.
{character:player}Can we get Mojito to show the staff of Countless Springs its friendly side?
{character:Ciri}Hmm?
{character:player}Have you noticed that the two staff over there seem to be terrified of Mojito?
Ciri looks where I'm looking and happens to make eye contact with a female employee who has braids and is wearing a pair of round glasses, causing her to suddenly pull her head back behind the door.
{character:player}We've come here today to learn more about the situation from Kurone Toujou. It won't be worth it if we're stuck here at the door because the staff are scared of Mojito.
Ciri frowns as she thinks for a moment, then she sighs.
{character:Ciri}Ah, I know.
{character:Ciri}Mojito, put on a good show in a moment and be nice to them.
{character:Ciri}Go and get them to come over here.
{character:player}Okay.
After receiving Ciri's permission, out of basic trust in an outstanding animal tamer, I walk up to the staff of Countless Springs to have a talk with them.
{character:player}Hello there. I'm a friend of that black panther over there.
{character:Male Staff}H-Hi, can I help you with anything?
{character:player}Here's the thing, I know you won't believe me if I tell you that the black panther is actually very well-behaved.
{character:Female Staff}Well... It is a black panther after all. I don't see them often even at the zoo.
{character:player}Would you like to go over and pet it?
{character:Female Staff}Ah! W-Will it bite people?

{character:player}No. The person standing next to it is Ciri, the most famous animal tamer of Soul. This black panther performs with her all the time and has friendly interactions with members of the audience during performances.
{character:Male Staff}Ciri... that name sounds familiar. Has she been here before? Our colleagues from the previous shift have mentioned her name before.
{character:Female Staff}It seems like she is one of our regulars...

The two staff members look at each other. I don't know if it's because they trust Ciri or because they realize that they can't just let Mojito continue to lie outside the entrance of Countless Springs, but they finally decide to follow me all the way to Ciri and Mojito.
However, they are still very skeptical, standing two meters away from Mojito the whole time, and refuse to touch it.
It looks like they need someone to set a good example for them, and I'm the most suitable candidate among everyone present.
I squat down and whisper "please" to Mojito sincerely before reaching out with my right hand to touch its head.
However, Mojito reaches out and blocks me with its front paw with a look of disgust.
A hard-working human will never admit defeat. I dodge its sturdy paws calmly and suddenly extend my right hand quickly toward its head.
Before I know it, Mojito's front paw turns into an afterimage and blocks me once again.

It looks like I won't be able to beat it with speed, so I decide to use my intelligence. I pretend to reach out towards its head with my right hand again, but this time, I also try to touch its chin with my left hand with a pincer attack...
Mojito tilts its head to the left and successfully dodges my attack. It then growls at me, exhaling all over my face.
These setbacks won't stop me. Refusing to accept reality, I prepare to attack for a fourth time when I suddenly hear the laughter of the staff.
{character:Male Staff}This black panther has such a good temper.
{character:Female Staff}Yeah, it hasn't gotten angry even though it has been harassed so many times. This "big cat" is so cute, unlike that little tabby cat in the courtyard.
{character:Male Staff}Which one?
{character:Female Staff}The stray cat that came inside a few days ago. Kaori got scratched when touching its paws last week. The scabs are still there.
I don't know if Mojito understood what the staff said, but it shook its head and snorted twice.
{character:Female Staff}Look, it's being friendly to us. In that case, I think it will be fine to let it inside if the owners watch it carefully. What do you think?
{character:Male Staff}I guess it's... okay.
{character:Male Staff}You two... Did you three make an appointment in advance before coming to Countless Springs today? ...I see. In that case, please follow me, and remember to keep an eye on it.
{character:player}Relax! I promise that everything will be okay.
While we follow the staff into Countless Springs, I quietly ask Ciri what Mojito was saying with those snorting sounds.
{character:Ciri}Oh, it was saying that it hates humans who don't respect others' boundaries.
Seeing the obviously vigilant expressions of the staff, I feel like it won't do to let this stalemate continue, so I look at Ciri for help.
{character:Ciri}Sigh...
She sighs and snaps her fingers at Mojito. After that, Mojito grabs the ground with its two front paws and stretches its torso vigorously, making a textbook cat pose, before standing up.
The two staff members take a big step back in front, whereas I stay where I am and look carefully at the "big cat" in front of me.

When Mojito moves, its beautiful and smooth muscle lines show us its strength. To be honest, it's impossible to not be afraid, especially since I have never been in such close contact with Mojito before, but... I really want to pet it to find out how this black panther's fur feels.

After Mojito stands, instead of paying attention to the staff in the distance, it walks over to me and lowers its head, resting its furry head against the back of my hand, and rubs its head back and forth a few times while making a low growling noise.
I turn my hand around and carefully pet its head. Its fur is slightly firm to the touch and isn't as soft as I expected.
After seeing our interactions, the female staff can't resist coming up to us.
{character:Female Staff}I... Can I pet it too?
After getting Ciri's consent, she reaches out to Mojito.
But Mojito seems to like me more and hides its head behind me, refusing to interact with her.
Fortunately, the female staff is happy even though she didn't get to pet Mojito.

{character:Female Staff}This is my first time interacting with a real panther in my life. I didn't expect them to be such gentle creatures. As I thought, all species of cats are true friends of humans.
Ciri and I exchange a glance and tacitly decide not to disillusion her.
{character:Female Staff}I think it will be fine to let it inside if the owners watch it carefully. What do you think?
While we follow the staff into Countless Springs, I quietly ask Ciri a question.
{character:player}Why didn't Mojito let the staff touch it?
{character:Ciri}Letting two people touch it at the same time is beyond Mojito's scope of services. It's not a kitten at a cat café.
They both make money by acting cute, so it's a surprise to learn there is a chain of contempt!!!

Kurone Toujou is already waiting for us in the pavilion in the middle of the lake by the time we get inside Countless Springs. She is sitting behind a screen painted with birds singing in a bamboo forest. I can't see her appearance clearly, and all I can see are some indistinct shadows swaying with the breeze blowing through the pavilion.
Ciri doesn't act like a stranger in front of her. She skips the formalities and starts asking questions from the very beginning.
{character:Ciri}I've come to ask you about the situation that day when you picked up the red-crowned crane. The more details you can give me the better.
Kurone Toujou
{character:Kurone Toujou}You're as impatient as ever, hehe. However, it's been a few days now, so please give me some time to think about what happened.

{character:Kurone Toujou}It was around 10 PM that night when I met the red-crowned crane, and I was just coming back from the East Wind dojo... I think someone was chasing it at that time, and it no longer had the strength to get back up again after it fell to the ground in front of me.
{character:Kurone Toujou}It was when I picked it up that I noticed the serious injuries on its wings and legs.
{character:Ciri}Were you the only one there at that time?

{character:Kurone Toujou}Yes, I didn't have anyone accompany me because East Wind dojo isn't far from Countless Springs... Of course, I didn't dare to rashly confront the people chasing after it at that time, so I took it and hid in a nearby 24-hour convenience store.
{character:Ciri}Didn't those people search the convenience store?
{character:Kurone Toujou}Maybe they thought the red-crowned crane wouldn't go inside a convenience store by itself... Anyway, they didn't search that place at that time.
{character:Ciri}Did you see who they were?
{character:Kurone Toujou}Through the glass at night, I think I could vaguely see... a group of people who were dressed like thugs and had weapons with them.
Upon hearing this, Ciri suddenly punches the pillar next to her and gives me a fright.
{character:Ciri}They tricked us.

I instantly understand what she is saying. Ciri thinks that the thug Shijukara we met the other day must have been talking about this red-crowned crane. He was probably lying when he said he was looking for a man called red-crowned crane.
{character:player}Should we ask Shijukara again to make sure?
{character:Ciri}Our current problem is... we don't know where he is hiding out and have no way to find him.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Oh, you two know Shijukara?
{character:player}Not really...
I quickly explain the events of the other day to Kurone Toujou.
{character:player}It sounds like you also know this Shijukara?
{character:Kurone Toujou}To tell you the truth, I do know him. Countless Springs and Raven have some business dealings, and Shijukara often delivers things here for Soumu, the boss of Raven.
{character:player}Huh?
{character:Kurone Toujou}Do you have any questions?
{character:player}Oh, it's not that. I'm just a little surprised that Countless Springs has business dealings with gangs.

{character:Kurone Toujou}I hope you don't get the wrong idea. Although Raven is quite well-known in the underworld, they have been undergoing a transformation in recent years and now operate many legal businesses, so they operate on both sides of the law.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Countless Springs has business dealings with their legal businesses. It's not just us. Even the famous Samu Corporation has business dealings with them.
{character:player}Then you must know where we can find Shijukara, right?
{character:Kurone Toujou}I don't know where Shijukara might be, but you can ask other members of Raven... Please give me a moment.
After a short wait, Kurone Toujou passes over a piece of paper with an address on it from behind the screen.
{character:Kurone Toujou}You'll be able to find members of Raven here. This is their nearest hideout around Countless Springs.
{character:player}Thank you so much.
{character:Kurone Toujou}It's my pleasure to help you with your troubles, but...
{character:player}But?

{character:Kurone Toujou}Although I don't know much about the business scope of Raven, based on my understanding of what Soumu is like as a person... his way of doing things may not be appreciated by everyone, but hurting the red-crowned crane doesn't seem like his style.
{character:Kurone Toujou}I shouldn't get involved because I'm a third party, but I hope you can listen to my advice.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Don't be impulsive. Try to resolve everything peacefully. It would be best if you could solve everything through amicable communication.
Kurone Toujou makes a lot of sense. Not to mention, no matter how good Ciri is in a fight, we'll be heavily outnumbered on their turf.
Ciri and I exchange a glance and decide to see what their attitude is like before discussing further plans.

I think carefully about Shijukara's attitude on that day. Although I feel that he was beaten into submission in the end, his confusion when Ciri questioned him didn't look like an act... If it was, then I'm confident to say that he is a better actor than 90% of the actors in the current entertainment industry.
With this thought in mind, I decide to ask Kurone Toujou for more details.
{character:player}Do you remember if those thugs had any obvious characteristics or features?
{character:Kurone Toujou}Um... It was too dark that night, and I couldn't see them clearly.
{character:Kurone Toujou}But...
{character:Kurone Toujou}If you want to start investigating with the thugs, I think I know of someone who can help you.
{character:player}Who?
{character:Kurone Toujou}Raven is the largest gang in One Han City, and all the thugs in the east side of One Han City listen to its orders.
{character:Ciri}No, they could be the ones behind this. There's no way they would help us sincerely.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Oh? Can you tell me why?
Hearing Kurone Toujou's somewhat surprised inquiry, I smile bitterly and quickly tell her what happened yesterday.
{character:Kurone Toujou}With that said... actually, Raven has been undergoing a transformation in recent years and now operates many legal businesses, so they operate on both sides of the law.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Countless Springs is a customer of one of those legal businesses, so I also have some dealings with Soumu, the boss of Raven.

{character:Kurone Toujou}Based on my humble opinion, Soumu doesn't seem like someone who would do something like this. Or should I say he disdains to do something like this? There might be a misunderstanding.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Please give me a moment.
{character:Kurone Toujou}You'll be able to find members of Raven here. This is their nearest hideout around Countless Springs.
{character:Kurone Toujou}Don't be impulsive. Try to resolve everything peacefully. It would be best if you could solve everything through amicable communication and get them to help you.
After bidding farewell to Kurone Toujou, Ciri and I go to the address and arrive at the entrance of the Raven hideout. I don't know what to say... It's actually an ordinary mahjong dojo.
Just as Ciri and I are hesitating about whether we should go inside, we see someone familiar: Shijukara.
It's obvious that Shijukara also saw us too. The moment our eyes lock, both he and Ciri start moving quickly.
He started running away, and she started chasing after him. There's no way he is getting away.
Ciri drags Shijukara in front of me by his collar, and I sigh when I see him.
{character:player}Sigh, you keep showing up. We've seen you a lot in the last two days.
Shijukara
{character:Shijukara}Do you think I'm doing it on purpose? I don't want to see you either. Nothing good happens when I run into you.
{character:player}It's not that bad. We have come in peace this time.
{character:Shijukara}You can't fool me!
{character:player}I'm serious. Kurone Toujou told us to come here. Look, this paper with this address on it also has Countless Springs's logo on it
Shijukara dubiously takes the note from my hand, then he looks over it a few times.
{character:Shijukara}So what have you come here for?
{character:player}Can I talk to your boss, Soumu? There's something we want to ask him.
{character:Shijukara}Hah! Do you think our boss is someone who any random person can see?
{character:Shijukara}But... I have to show our major customer Countless Springs some respect. It just happens that the boss is here checking up on our business. I'll bring you to meet him.
Ciri tells Mojito to wait for us outside the dojo, then we follow Shijukara inside the dojo. It is bustling with people inside, and there really are many ordinary citizens playing mahjong here.
{character:player}Why is your gang hideout a mahjong dojo?
{character:Shijukara}You don't understand, right? We do business legally here.
{character:Shijukara}What business is more legal here in One Han City than a mahjong dojo?
I think he makes a lot of sense.
{character:Shijukara}What's more, most of the dojos in the west side of One Han City are run by Strix. Well, we can't lose to them! We must outnumber them.
Is this some mode of business war that I'm unaware of?

{character:player}Nowadays, most businesses compete by making snide comments on each other's CatChat posts, or by arranging fights between the leaders and streaming the process live... I never expected that there are still people who compete honestly in terms of the number of stores they run.

{character:Shijukara}Haha, it's obvious that you haven't followed the CatChat accounts of the bosses of the two gangs. There's no way they wouldn't take part in a real business war like what you mentioned.
Shijukara's words manage to capture my attention. I must watch it the next time I get a chance.

We follow Shijukara into a room at the back. As soon as I enter the door, a person with an imposing back throws a mahjong tile in the smoke, which makes a crisp sound when it collides with the discarded tiles.
{character:???}West Wind.

The player who moves after him is facing us from the side. He is wearing a suit and has a slicked-back hairstyle. He plays a 1 Pin with a confident expression on his face, then we see a guy with a side part hairstyle smack the table hard.
Guy with Side Part Hair
{character:Guy with Side Part Hair}What's wrong with you? No one plays a 1 Pin after 3 West Winds.
Guy with a Crew Cut
{character:Guy with a Crew Cut}That's right! You're making trouble on purpose and trying to curse us, aren't you?
Guy with Slicked Back Hair
{character:Guy with Slicked Back Hair}You have nothing to worry about if you have a clear conscience. Look, the boss hasn't said anything yet.

Just as the atmosphere becomes tense after three of the people stand up, the man with his back to us takes a puff of the cigarette in his hand, then he speaks calmly after casually dusting the ashes into the ashtray next to him.
{character:???}Is it necessary to talk so much when playing mahjong?
The other three players instantly fall quiet. Although they don't look happy, none of them speak, and they all sit back down.
It looks like this person must be Soumu, the boss of Raven.
Shijukara sneers disdainfully beside me then walks up to the man with his back to us and speaks to him in a low voice.
{character:Shijukara}Boss, Countless Springs referred these two people to us.

The moment he hears the words Countless Springs, he turns his head and glances at us out of the corner of his eye. After that, he turns his head back and continues to play mahjong. After one turn, just as Ciri's patience is about to run out, he finally says something to us.
Soumu
{character:Soumu}People from Countless Springs? Did you just come here to sit quietly and say nothing?
Hmm... It looks like it'll be difficult to get along with this man. While I'm still thinking of a tactful way to ask my question, Ciri speaks fearlessly.
{character:Ciri}Are you behind the recent wildlife trafficking in One Han City?
She really is a superwoman.
Soumu sucks hard on the cigarette between his fingers, then speaks sarcastically after exhaling the smoke.

{character:Soumu}Raven isn't that short of money yet. There are so many businesses for me to choose from every day. I might even end up with the police on my back if I go to such lengths to capture some animals... Haha, are you stupid, or do you think I'm stupid?
{character:Soumu}3 Pin... Didn't you guys eat anything before shuffling the tiles?
Standing on my tiptoes, I glance at the discarded tiles in front of Soumu. He played a 3 Pin tile in 3 consecutive turns. His tile luck is quite amazing.
Ciri naturally doesn't believe what he's saying. She snorts coldly and has already started reaching for the whip on her waist. I quickly grab her hand.
{character:player}Let me take care of this.
{character:Soumu}3 Pin...
I take a small step forward, but then I step back quickly after hearing that he played a 3 Pin. This distance is safer after all.
I quickly explain the events of the other day and share what Kurone Toujou told us to Soumu.
Although I deliberately omit the part where Ciri beat up Shijukara and the others, Soumu sneers. Damn, I think I said the wrong thing.
{character:Soumu}So you're the ones who beat them up the other day.
He doesn't look back at us when he says this, so I don't know what expression he is making and can't tell if he mentioned this because he is thinking of getting revenge for Shijukara.
Clap--Clap--Clap-- While I'm still thinking of an explanation, Soumu puts down the mahjong tile in his hand and starts clapping.
{character:Soumu}Good job.
{character:player}Huh?
I watch with surprise as Soumu turns around and suddenly kicks Shijukara next to me fiercely.

Shijukara rolls all the way to the sofa on the other side of the room and only manages to stabilize himself after grabbing a handrail while kneeling on the ground, which shows that the kick is just as powerful as Ciri's whip lash the other day.
{character:Soumu}I've been too busy dealing with business matters recently, so I haven't had time to train these trash. If you didn't make them realize that they are useless...
{character:Soumu}Hah! If they keep degenerating like this, how can I expect these trash to fight bravely for me?

I want to remind him that there are many peaceful ways to resolve disputes in modern society, but I choose to keep my mouth closed after seeing the shape of his pectoral muscles under his tight clothes and his massive fists.
Even if Ciri can beat Shijukara, it doesn't mean she can beat Soumu. It's completely unnecessary to start a conflict.
Soumu lights up another cigarette and blows a few smoke rings in the air slowly before he seems to have made a decision.
{character:Soumu}I can't turn a blind eye to it since this happened on our turf. Come here at this time tomorrow, and I'll give you an answer.
